tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, database performance tuning, and cloud deployments. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer bringing a hands-on mentality and solid technical expertise for digital transformation projects.

cover_en.subject: Application: Consultant SAP CX (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Consultant SAP CX position at Telekom MMS. With over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a solid technical foundation in enterprise solutions and customer-centric digital projects.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce & Backend
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: API Development & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Cloud & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, ensuring stable platform operations.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked directly with international technical teams to investigate and resolve integration bottlenecks between ERP, MDM, and PIM platforms.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is rooted deeply in SAP Commerce Cloud rather than SAP Sales- and Service-Cloud V.2 or SAP BTP, I possess strong foundational knowledge in cloud applications and am very keen to learn these additional enterprise platforms.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. I am currently serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my technical background can support your customer projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Consultant SAP CX (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für die Position als Consultant SAP CX bei der Telekom MMS gelesen. Als erfahrene Entwicklerin mit über 5 Jahren Praxis im Bereich großer Enterprise-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte technologische Kenntnisse und eine strukturierte Hands-on-Mentalität mit.

bullets.label: Plattform-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) unter Verwendung von Java und Spring.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Integration von PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen über Hotfolders, DataHub und Profisee.

bullets.label: Cloud-Prozesse
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen technischen Teams und Durchführung von Code Reviews in agilen Umgebungen.

cover_de.gap: Spezifische Vorkenntnisse in SAP Sales- und Service-Cloud V.2 bringe ich aktuell noch nicht mit, bin jedoch hoch motiviert, mich in diese Bereiche schnell und engagiert einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026. Mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Telekom MMS to contribute my technical expertise in enterprise platforms to over 3,000 diverse customer projects. The opportunity to shape digital transformations for corporations and mid-sized companies in an interdisciplinary team with modern methodologies closely aligns with my professional background.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated backend and e-commerce developer with 5+ years of experience in SAP platforms, eager to bring my technical skills and hands-on mentality to innovative customer projects at Telekom MMS.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I saw your Consultant SAP CX opening at Telekom MMS and would love to connect. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting December 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Consultant SAP CX (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Consultant SAP CX position at Telekom MMS. With over 5 years of professional experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development, Java, and API integrations gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to support your digital projects.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, and available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
